setting: You are all on the night shift at a warehouse in Johannesburg, South Africa, where you know each other as coworkers, and you use this chat to coordinate shift swaps and pass along what's happening on the floor between the dispatch desk, the inventory office and the loading bay.

text: [file: dispatch sheet 01 Dec night.pdf]
Got it. Bay 3 still blocked?
Yeah, forklift on the ramp till they fix the hydraulic. Dispatch wants 4 trucks out before 2
Ok. Aisle C count still off by 40 from last week. I'll flag it tonight
ey is it still 6 to 6?
6pm to 6am yes
cool cool
guys the kombi broke down on the N12 😭 might be late, taking a taxi now
Which taxi. The one from kempton?
ya the one that charges 5 rand more
Get here before 18:30 or dispatch gives you the 19:00 calls and you're stuck on the bay
I'll tell dispatch you're coming. They'll put you on pallets first
legend
here. where do i sign in
Desk. Nomsa has the key to the cage
I'm not your key holder 😂 it's in the drawer
Bay 3 is open. Trucks 1 and 2 are loaded
Aisle C count done. 38 short. Put it on the sheet so dispatch knows before the morning call
Done
Truck 3 is late, driver says 00:30
my hand pallet strap snapped back at me
How bad
not bad. bleeding a bit. going to the first aid box
You need to sit down and let someone look at it. Not on the pallets
ok ok. nomsa can you cover the strap station
I'm on the count sheet. Ask themba
I'll take the strap station. You sit at the desk
Truck 3 is out
Inventory office is locked, I need the second key from you Themba
On the hook by the scanner
the first aid kit is empty 😭 ran out of plasters
There's a box in the cage with the cleaning stuff
found it
Trucks 4 and 5 are at the gate. Bay 3 closes at 06:00
Ok. Count sheet is done and sent
hand's fine. i'm still putting it on the pallets though. it's only one hand 😂
No you're on the desk till the last truck leaves
